_note: Structure inferred from the brief's requirements — replace this file's fields with the official participant-pack template if the exact schema differs.

requirements.description: At least 60 students across two classes, six compulsory subjects, one optional fourth subject, practical subjects with separate theory/practical marks, and at least 8 students on hard edges (failed subject with strong average, practical fail with passing theory, optional below help threshold, absent in one subject).
requirements.evidence: data.js embeds the organizer-supplied fixture (25 cases, e.g. PUB-01 has 80 students across Class 9 and Class 10). All four named hard-edge cases are present and verified in the dataset (see README 'Proof requirements are met').

requirements.description: Work out each student's result: grade point per subject, final GPA, letter grade.
Per-student trace: mark used, grade point produced, and the rule that decided it for every subject; the subject that caused a fail must be identifiable for high-average students who still failed.
requirements.evidence: app.js openTrace()/subjectRow(): per-subject trace table with rule citations; failing compulsory subjects get a red-pen circle annotation and '← caused the fail' label.

requirements.description: Office checking list: every student affected by the optional-subject rule, a practical fail, or an absent mark.
requirements.evidence: app.js renderTabs()/renderTable(): three list tabs (Optional-Subject List, Practical-Fail List, Absent List) driven by engine.js evaluateCase().lists, each with a plain-language reason per student.

requirements.description: Grading rules R-10 to R-13 and the R-29 checking-list definitions implemented exactly as specified.
requirements.evidence: engine.js: GRADE_BANDS, THEORY_PASS/PRACTICAL_PASS constants, GPA formula with cap and compulsory-failure cancellation, R-29 list definitions.

known_limitations: Requires internet access on first load to fetch Google Fonts (Source Serif 4, IBM Plex Mono, Inter, Kalam); the app still functions with system fallback fonts if fonts.googleapis.com is unreachable.
No automated unit-test suite beyond a single headless-browser smoke test (smoke_test.js); correctness was verified by inspection and by cross-checking on-screen stats against the engine's own output.
data.js embeds all 25 fixture cases inline (~430 KB) for zero-server file:// compatibility; this is larger than a fetched JSON file would be over the wire.
